verdict.rationale: Guardrails are a fair axis for an agent orchestration framework, but the evidence pack documents no first-party input/output guardrail feature that validates, transforms, or blocks unsafe content. A community note says nodes can be arbitrary pre/post-processing functions, and the docs describe interrupts for human review. These are developer building blocks or adjacent controls, not a guardrails capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach input/output guardrails that validate, transform, or block unsafe content
